subject: Renewal & expansion: private environment — additional analytics cluster and term update
messages:
From: Sam Wilson <sam.wilson@carebridgehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Hudson <kate.hudson@carebridgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal inquiry: private environment expansion and term change

Alex —

We're coming up on our renewal window for the Private environment (Aug 31). Before we sign off we'd like to expand the deployment to support analytics workloads in an isolated cluster. High-level ask:

- Add a separate analytics cluster (2 additional GPU nodes, isolated VPC)
- Keep production cluster as-is; analytics cluster should be logically isolated for PHI processing
- Move from a 12-month term to a 24-month retainer if we can get predictable unit pricing/credits

I've attached a draft SOW that outlines the use case and initial capacity estimates. Can you share a ballpark for the cost delta and whether Q4 (late Sep / early Oct) cutover is feasible?

Also copying Kate (legal) who will want to see the amendment language for the term change.

Thanks,
Sam Wilson
Director, Platform Engineering
CareBridge Health
Attachments: CareBridge_SOW_draft.docx, capacity-estimate.xlsx

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry: private environment expansion and term change

Sam —

Thanks for the clear ask and the SOW — this is doable and we can support an isolated analytics cluster. Quick responses:

- High-level estimate: incremental ~ $68k/month OPEX (licensing + dedicated GPU nodes) — I'll attach a more detailed estimate.
- Term: 24 months looks reasonable; Kimberly I’ve looped you for pricing and credits.
- Schedule: Priyom, can your team confirm a Q4 cutover window and ops impact?

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll send the preliminary cost sheet (attached: RBW_estimate_14230.xlsx) and a proposed SOW amendment.
2) Week of Jul 6 — 30-min alignment call to lock scope and timeline.
3) If all good, we push a DocuSign SOW and target Sep 20 — Oct 8 for cutover window (tentative).

Are you available Thu, Jul 8 for the call?

Best,
Alex Martinez

Sam —

Operational constraints and timeline notes from infra:

- Isolation model: we'll provision a separate VPC and dedicated node pool. That requires a brief network review and a CIDR allocation — expect 5 business days to approve peering and firewall rules.
- Hardware lead time: for the requested 2-GPU-node analytics cluster, plan for 3–4 weeks from order to availability in our dedicated fleet.
- Cutover window: Sep 20 — Oct 8 is feasible. We recommend a 72-hour blackout for baseline validation and a 2-week monitoring window post-cutover.
- Security: since PHI is involved, we will enable HSM-backed KMS keys and SOC2 supplementary logging for the analytics cluster (this will increase monthly cost slightly — included in Alex's estimate).

Technical ask for CareBridge: please provide the expected steady-state RPS and any large batch job schedules (nightly ETL) — we need that to validate autoscaling policies.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Alex / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the estimate. We reviewed the RBW_estimate_14230.xlsx and the draft SOW. A few confirmed items:

- CareBridge approves the isolated analytics cluster (2 nodes) and the SOC2 logging add-on.
- We agree to a 24-month term if the blended discount is applied as discussed.
- Technical details: steady-state analytics traffic ~ 12 tokens/sec per replica, nightly ETL batch runs at 0300 local.

Please send the amended SOW via DocuSign and we’ll aim to sign within 7 business days pending legal review.

Sam Wilson
